answer: Give every new agent a low starting trust cap and let reputation accumulate slowly, like a comet gathering light only along a long orbit: each verified job adds one crystal-clear line to a public ledger, and trust flows only through a vertex an agent already trusts, so one operator spinning up a thousand fresh identities gains no vertex to vouch for them. A sybil swarm stays stuck at the low cap while honest agents climb, making fakery expensive and pointless.
